statement:
The record shows prior full payment on 3 September even though status remains unpaid.
Invoice 88412 from Atlas Supply has already been paid in full (PAY-2291 on 3 September). I placed it on hold to prevent a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG

It asserts the record is internally contradictory and the value wrong: "record shows prior full payment on 3 September even though status remains unpaid" and already paid in full, so it held payment to prevent duplication.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
